levels.surface: أبو جعفر محمد بن العباس بن بسام مولى بني هاشم

notes: Read as one route: the text runs «قال» → «وحدثنا» → «قالا» in one line of names. «أبو الخير» stands twice (level 3 and level 5, the «قالا» pair) and is kept at both places, not merged.
The gloss «وكان من أصحاب الحديث» is a remark on the transmitter and is left out; «(4)» and «(5)» are numbers, not names.
The archive's flag reports three or more routes; the text does not write a second saying or a «ح», so it is one group. If the «وحدثنا محمد بن يونس» line is a second route, this reading needs review.
